feedback.goal: Run the G0/G1 paired demonstration on the vertical slice and report honest measured evidence: tools-based runs over the mock service with execution receipts, two proposer iterations with human application, and paired promotion-gate numbers.

acceptance_criteria.statement: G0 baseline (fault issue_refund=unknown, tools-based): measured 2/5 with receipts and business outcomes recorded.
Propose iteration 1 (drf-e4070460) diagnoses the orders-projection defect from goal/actual digests; human applies the projection fix; after batch measures 4/5 with no regressions.
Propose iteration 2 (drf-522e0b3c) diagnoses partial-refund status semantics; human applies; final batch measures 5/5.

The proposer gains pinned dsh plugin-contract knowledge (docs/dsh-plugin-contract.md + capsule) wired into the payload and output contract, addressing the operator's observation that the proposer lacked Cordis/plugin grounding.
Full gate green; receipts and evidence committed on the branch.

outcome.summary: Vertical slice demonstrated: G0 2/5, proposer-attributed projection fix to 4/5, proposer-attributed partial-refund semantics fix to 5/5, all with execution receipts, business outcomes, and a pinned plugin contract feeding the proposer.

what_worked: The check-level goal/actual digests we added in the trace round let the proposer prove the first failure was agent-independent (digest equality), not guess it.
The immutable-per-fingerprint cluster store surfaced a real iteration-loop limitation (member sets grow across batches); per-batch cluster stores were the working fix and are documented.
Both proposer drafts came back on harness_code with exact reproductions of the failing digests; human application was one-line changes with regression tests.
what_failed: G1 still failed task-004 (partial refund status semantics) — correctly attributed by the second proposer iteration and fixed.

calls.name: demo-runs
calls.purpose: Run G0, after, and g2 batches in the demo container under verified decisions, with receipts.

calls.name: propose-iterations
calls.purpose: Two governed proposer calls, human application of both fixes, regression tests.

calls.name: plugin-contract
calls.purpose: Pin the dsh plugin contract as proposer knowledge and wire it into the payload/output contract.

calls.name: pnpm-check
calls.purpose: Run the full repository verification gate and commit evidence.

failures_and_inefficiencies.summary: Cluster records are immutable per fingerprint, so re-clustering a growing run store across batches conflicts when the member set changes.
failures_and_inefficiencies.suggested_action: Per-batch cluster stores were used for the demo; the long-term fix is fingerprint-plus-batch cluster identity or member-set appends — queued on the branch roadmap.

evidence.summary: Measured batches: G0 2/5, after 4/5, g2 5/5 under identical faults and model; fifteen execution receipts committed under .dal/outbox/e2e-receipts; run records carry business outcomes.
Two proposer drafts (drf-e4070460 projection; drf-522e0b3c partial-refund semantics) with digest-verified diagnoses and falsifiable predictions; human-applied with regression tests.
Pinned dsh plugin contract (bundles, patch rows, tool registration, session seams, anchors) shipped as a capsule and wired into prepareProposePayload plus the output contract.
Typecheck, build, 154 tests, capsule checks, policy check, v0 suite, and benchmark suite all passed on improvements/audit-borrows.

uncertainty.statement: Single attempt per task per batch: the 2/5 to 5/5 deltas are demonstration evidence, not a statistical claim.
uncertainty.resolution: Multi-seed paired rollouts and pass@k remain the roadmap's stochastic-discipline milestone; receipts make the re-runs cheap to perform.

notes: Operator-approved demonstration: batch decision dec-g0g1-demo-batches-20260830 plus propose decisions dec-g0g1-propose-20260830 and dec-g1g2-propose-20260830 verified at each operation.
